bagPolicy.summary: Only clear bags 12" x 6" or smaller are allowed. Backpacks are not permitted.
bagPolicy.note: Strollers must be checked at the VIP Lobby entrance. For bag questions, call the venue at 305-284-8686.

parking.summary: Official venue guidance provides event parking information.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific rideshare guidance.
rideshare.note: Guests with disabilities may be dropped off at the front of Watsco Center. Any vehicle may use this drop-off point.

concessions.summary: Eight concession stands on the Main Concourse (second floor), operated by Chartwells, serve burgers, hot dogs, chicken tenders, pizza, nachos, and snacks. Outside food and beverages are not allowed, including water bottles and mugs. Alcohol is sold only at select adult-oriented events, with valid ID.

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair access is through the Suite/Elevator Entrance on the south side of the building, and ADA seating is available throughout for the guest with a disability and one companion. Accessible parking is in all surrounding lots with a state-issued placard or plate, and any vehicle can drop off a guest at the front. Tell any event staffer at an entrance if you need an ADA representative to help you to your seat.

reEntry.summary: Official venue guidance states that guests may not re-enter after leaving the venue.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The reviewed official venue guidance does not state a specific ticket-pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Wheelchair access is through the Suite/Elevator Entrance on the south side of the building. ADA representatives can help guests using wheelchairs or crutches at any entrance; just ask an event staffer.
